sections.name: HydrationWidget
sections.title: Water glass counter and display
sections.what: Keeps a running count of glasses with a goal of eight, starting at four. Shows the total in milliliters, the count out of the goal, a percentage, and a bar filled to that percentage. The minus and add buttons change the count within the limits of zero and eight.
sections.why: Gives the user a simple way to log water and see progress toward a daily target.
sections.watch_out: The count is held only in the browser's memory, so it is lost when the page reloads, and the fixed starting value of four is not based on real data.

summary: A dashboard card where the user counts glasses of water toward a daily goal of eight.
purpose: Lets the user log water intake and see progress toward the goal.
why: A simple tracker that gives quick feedback. Reason for not saving the data is not stated in the code.
how: It starts at four glasses and keeps the count in memory. The plus button adds a glass up to eight, and the minus button removes one down to zero. It shows the total in milliliters at 250 per glass, a percentage, and a progress bar.
outputs: A card showing glasses, milliliters, a percentage and a progress bar.
risks: The count is not saved, so refreshing the page resets it to four. The starting value of four is a fixed number, so the widget will show it even on a new day.
debug: If the count resets on refresh, that is expected because nothing is stored. If the bar does not move, check the percentage calculation and the goal value.
